chunks: 5052 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Harith ibn Al-Ahwal, from Burayd Al-ʿIjli, from Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding a slave woman who commits adultery, he عليه السلام said: "She is to be lashed half the prescribed punishment, whether she has a husband or does not have a husband."

key_terms.نِصْفَ الْحَدِّ: half of the prescribed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for a slave woman who commits adultery in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for a slave woman who commits adultery. Imam Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that her punishment is half of the full hadd, regardless of whether she is married or unmarried.
